Current Latest RELEASE Version: 2.1.0-RELEASE

The current latest RELEASE version is OpenRTM-aist-2.1.0-RELEASE.

  • ** Release Notes **
    • ** C++ **
    • ** Python **
    • ** Java **
    • ** tools (OpenRTP) **

Windows Installer

Only the 64-bit version is available. Running the downloaded MSI installs the C++ version, Python version, Java version, OpenRTP, rtshell, OpenCV 4.13.0, omniORB 4.3.4, and JRE 8.

OpenRTM-aist-2.1.0-RELEASE_x86_64.msi MD5:e1804a5aaa4fab85a5cdc777bd9c48c1 2026/06/02

If you are using Microsoft Edge and are unable to download the file, please refer to the following page for instructions.

  • Get Started with OpenRTM-aist in 10 Minutes! - Downloading OpenRTM-aist

The required software, Visual Studio and Python, supports the following versions:

  • Visual Studio (2019, 2022, 2026)
  • Python (3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14)

On Windows, make sure that the Python version number is displayed at the command prompt.
If it is not displayed, please refer to Python Version Number Is Not Displayed After Installing Python on Windows.

For installation instructions, please refer to Installing OpenRTM-aist 2.1 on Windows.
If you are installing OpenRTM-aist for the first time, please refer to Get Started with OpenRTM-aist in 10 Minutes!.

Linux Packages

On Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 (amd64 and arm64 environments), paste and execute the following command at the shell prompt to install the C++ version, Python version, Java version, OpenRTP (amd64 only), rtshell, and JDK 8.

$ bash <(curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenRTM/OpenRTM-aist/master/scripts/openrtm2_install_ubuntu.sh)

For installation instructions, please refer to Installing OpenRTM-aist 2.1 on Linux.

Raspberry Pi OS Packages

On Bookworm (64-bit environment), paste and execute the following command at the shell prompt to install the C++ version, Python version, Java version, and rtshell.

$ bash <(curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenRTM/OpenRTM-aist/master/scripts/openrtm2_install_raspbian.sh)

For installation instructions, please refer to Installing OpenRTM-aist 2.1 on Raspberry Pi OS.

Mac Packages

The C++ version, Python version, and OpenRTP can be installed on Mac. Please refer to the README on the following page for installation instructions.
https://github.com/OpenRTM/homebrew-openrtm2
